correctness.rationale: For every nonempty block S of K_{m,n}, a paired-dominating set is exactly one with equal positive part populations, because K_{a,b} has perfect matching iff a=b>0 and then dominates K_{m,n}. Nonpaired blocks have nonzero signed imbalance; partners iff their imbalances sum to 0. Therefore each distinct |d| yields exactly one complete bipartite PCG component with p_d,q_d>=1; the feasibility m=t+sum d*p_d, n=t+sum d*q_d is necessary and constructive (allocate t neutral pairs to a block). Distinct positive d each use at least d vertices from BOTH sides; sum d>=c(c+1)/2 gives the sharp maximum c and all c by explicit pure-block construction. Equality at m=n=T_c forces sizes 1..c and c! labeling quotient, giving (T_c!/prod j!)^2. The block-assembly bivariate labeled EGF treats each present sign as a nonempty SET of blocks, counts components u and blocks z without witness overcount. Independent enumeration of unlabeled set partitions of K_{2,4} and K_{3,3}, direct domination/matching checks, recovered 20 and 50 admissible partitions, with precisely nine 2-component partitions for K_{3,3}, confirming triangular extremal formula.
residual_risks: Finite direct check uses at most six base vertices; the proof of all m,n uses exact signed-imbalance characterization and labeled combinatorial species.
Paired-coalition number (number of blocks) is a distinct invariant from number of connected coalition graph components.

value.rationale: A full realization criterion for a natural coalition graph operator and an exact quantitative fragmentation law answer an intrinsic structural question beyond the scalar coalition number. The sharp triangular cutoff identifies the minimum resource cost of c distinct partner-imbalance magnitudes; the two-variable labeled generating function captures exact global partition data and can be used to recover many invariants. Distinct full-space classification and EGF are mathematically motivated, not a small arbitrary slice.
residual_risks: Scope is complete bicliques, and the existential integer criterion is not a closed formula for unlabeled coalition graph isomorphism types.

limitations: No assertion for general multipartite/noncomplete bipartite/ordinary coalition graphs.
Exhaustive independent check K2,4 and K3,3 only; the arbitrary-order claims are symbolic.
